# Lab 13.12: Troubleshoot a VPC-SC Violation

## What We Are Going to Do
Reproduce a blocked request, find its unique ID, read the violation, and fix the perimeter safely.

## Steps

1. **Cause a violation.** As Alice in Cloud Shell, run:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage cat gs://YOUR_PROJECT_ID-vpcsc/data.txt</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The error includes a **vpcServiceControlsUniqueId**. Copy it.

2. **Use the troubleshooter.** Go to **Security → VPC Service Controls → Troubleshoot**, paste the unique ID and click **Troubleshoot**. It shows the perimeter, the service, the identity and why access was denied.

3. **Find the log entry.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • TEXT
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">protoPayload.metadata.@type="type.googleapis.com/google.cloud.audit.VpcServiceControlAuditMetadata"
protoPayload.metadata.vpcServiceControlsUniqueId="UNIQUE_ID"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Note `violationReason`, for example `NO_MATCHING_ACCESS_LEVEL`, and `ingressViolations`.

4. **Decide the fix.** Ask: should Alice really have access? If yes, add her to the ingress rule, ideally with an access level as the source, not `*`.

5. **Test the fix in dry-run first.** Copy the enforced config to dry-run, change it, and check the logs.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud access-context-manager perimeters dry-run update lab_perimeter \
  --set-ingress-policies=ingress-with-alice.yaml --policy=$POLICY_ID
gcloud access-context-manager perimeters dry-run enforce lab_perimeter --policy=$POLICY_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud access-context-manager perimeters delete lab_perimeter --policy=$POLICY_ID
gcloud storage rm --recursive gs://$PROJECT_ID-vpcsc</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Unique ID | Links the error to the exact log entry |
| Troubleshooter | Explains the denial in plain terms |
| Common reasons | No access level, resource outside the perimeter |
| Safe change | Dry-run first, then enforce |
